relationships.subject: TrkA
relationships.evidence_quote: Immunostaining for CGRP showed significant reductions among TrkAF592A animals in comparison to TrkAWT mice

relationships.subject: Rimegepant
relationships.evidence_quote: separately blocked CGRP signaling using FDA-approved Rimegepant. Both strategies led to significant reductions in sarcoma growth, vascularity, and sarcoma-induced hyperalgesia.

relationships.evidence_quote: a significant reduction of VEGFA immunoreactivity was quantified among TrkAF592A animals (82.6% reduction; SI Appendix, Fig. S9L)

relationships.subject: NGF
relationships.evidence_quote: Skeletal innervating sensory neurons commonly express the high-affinity NGF receptor TrkA (27).

key_findings: TrkA inhibition reduced sarcoma innervation (82% CGRP+ fibers), vascularization, tumor growth, metastasis and prolonged survival
Rimegepant CGRP blockade reduced sarcoma growth, vascularity and hyperalgesia
